concepts.prompt: Game pickup item concept: an adventurer's travel backpack standing upright. A chunky rounded leather and tan canvas backpack with a big front pocket, flap closure with brass buckles, two shoulder straps on the back, and a rolled sage-green blanket bedroll strapped horizontally across the top with leather straps. Earthy brown leather and tan canvas like the sack in the second reference, chunky oversized proportions. About 0.55 m tall. Stylised Palworld / Animo-class game item prop, deliberately chunky and oversized, exaggerated readable silhouette that still reads clearly from 10-15 metres, soft bevelled edges, soft hand-painted PBR look, natural palette matching the Meadows key-art reference (sage and leaf greens, warm gold, cream, slate blue, teal). Single isolated object standing upright on its flat base, full object visible and centred, plain neutral light-grey background, even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no ground plane, no people, no creatures, no text, no letters, no labels, no red or crimson anywhere.
reference_paths: software render of assets/props/quaternius_fantasy/Bag.gltf (front/3-4/side), silhouette and material reference
concepts.verdict: CHOSEN: chunky tan canvas backpack with brown leather flap, pockets, brass buckles, shoulder straps, sage-green bedroll strapped on top; side, back and front views consistent

agent_visual_verdict: Good: chunky tan canvas backpack, brown leather flap and pockets with brass buckles, side pockets, shoulder straps, sage-green bedroll strapped on top with two leather straps; faceted low-poly-friendly style. 0.45 x 0.55 x 0.37 m.
